name: api-documentation-explorer
title: API Documentation Explorer
description: An interactive API reference explorer with HTTP method badges (GET, POST), parameter tables, and live response simulation.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Api Endpoint Try It Out Request: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
